ownership.nativeRecovery: Independent helper source review and preparation of bounded author-integrity controls. No native host call is authorized to this reviewer by this freeze.
ownership.root: Implementation, native materialization, positive installation, current identity/resource admission and actual installed entry calls unless explicitly delegated later.

controls.method: Source review plus exact byte/hash/Git-object admission of the six new maintained helpers and original bounded carrier; compare all three assets to the independent constants above, not only the self-described carrier or installation marker.
controls.required: Only those three fixed asset paths/types are admitted; every asset is complete and exact before any destination creation. Asset bytes are copied directly. Reject malformed, duplicate, missing, unexpected or unsafe paths without deriving a write path from unvalidated carrier names.
controls.effectEvidence: Record the validation-to-mkdir ordering in source review; retain exact source/carrier pins and the adversarial payload outcome in A2.

controls.method: One owned negative carrier derived from an exact admitted carrier, changing one byte of an asset while retaining the original declared digest. Invoke the actual installer against a distinct absent author-control destination.
controls.required: A nonzero refusal occurs and the requested destination remains absent. No partial destination, opener dispatch or source/runtime modification occurs.
controls.effectEvidence: Retain mutation offset/original and replacement byte, original and changed carrier hashes, exact argv/stdout/stderr/exit, and before/after absence observations. Do not use this failure to replace the legitimate carrier or repeat the positive installation.

controls.method: One distinct owned author-control directory, already containing a known sentinel, is passed as destination with the genuine carrier.
controls.required: Refusal is nonzero before any destination mutation. The directory's complete bounded file inventory, regular-file bytes/hashes/modes and sentinel remain identical.
controls.effectEvidence: Retain full before/after manifest and exact outcome. The legitimate final installation and any older installation are not used as a writable negative fixture.

controls.method: Review that INSTALLATION.json is created exclusively and last after all installed files have been independently verified. For the dynamic refusal control, use a separate owned incomplete installation specimen with no marker; run the exact opener normal path under an author dispatch spy.
controls.required: A missing marker produces refusal before any /usr/bin/open dispatch. The spy must record zero calls. It must never invoke the actual desktop opener.
controls.effectEvidence: Keep the actual helper bytes unmodified, preserve the specimen and exact outcome, and label the in-process dispatch spy as author-control evidence rather than native shebang/browser proof.

controls.method: In a separate bounded author specimen of a valid installation, change one byte of a product asset while preserving the marker and original expected digest. Run the exact opener normal path under the same dispatch spy.
controls.required: Refusal precedes opener dispatch, and the spy records zero calls. Exact qualified source and the legitimate installation remain unchanged.
controls.effectEvidence: Retain specimen before/after manifests, mutation details, exact output/refusal, and source preservation. Do not repair/delete the specimen or overwrite prior evidence.

controls.method: Source review and one genuine complete author specimen executed under the dispatch spy; record the requested executable/argv after successful verification.
controls.required: Only /usr/bin/open receives exactly the validated installed HTML file URL after complete inventory validation. No shell expansion, server, dependency install, network call or background process is introduced by the helper.
controls.effectEvidence: The recorded call is evidence of dispatch intent only; no actual default-profile open or browser-use claim is made.

controls.method: Consume root's actual native calls to the final installed executable entry by its absolute path, once with --check and once with --no-open. The OS must use the exact shebang, rather than an explicitly supplied interpreter or shell.
controls.required: Both return success with complete bounded output. --check validates the full installed inventory; --no-open returns the exact file URL of the original pinned HTML. Neither flag dispatches the desktop opener. The entry uses the admitted existing Python with -B and installed open.py.
controls.effectEvidence: Record generated command bytes/mode/shebang, argv/PID/exit/stdout/stderr/closure and exact URL. Static source or author-spy success cannot substitute for these two native entry observations.

controls.method: Compare the original carrier, all six maintained helper files, all three qualified assets, existing pinned Python, and the legitimate final installation's complete inventory before/after the authorized controls; consume root's prior-installation/runtime boundary evidence.
controls.required: Only explicitly new owned control specimens/evidence are written. No original input, runtime, existing installation, private/default profile or shared config is changed. Retain partial new directories and every original failure; no cleanup or blind replay.
controls.effectEvidence: Report each source-review/control/native-entry status separately. Incomplete capture, timeout, unknown child state, absent hash or unexpected outcome stays unresolved or failed, never passed by inference.

bounds.authorControls: Fixed named specimens under the already-admitted new author root only, with aggregate source/installation writes inside the root contract's 4 MiB cap; controls do not run LP solver/math groups or browsers.
bounds.capture: Propose bounded stdout/stderr and per-child deadlines in the concrete harness before native execution; exact source/body retained in Git.
bounds.noHostCall: This reviewer does not execute native calls, open a profile, clean temporary state or install runtimes/dependencies. Root must own or explicitly delegate any concrete native control run.

reviewAdditionalRisks: Review absolute-path admission, symlink/type refusal, complete inventory coverage, release-to-source binding, bounded reads/JSON admission, safe command quoting and publication of the completion marker only after verification. These are source-review obligations; add dynamic cases only for a concrete unresolved risk, without expanding to a generic test framework.
